items.title: Tennessee State Board of Education postpones vote on teacher licensure requirements
items.summary: The State Board of Education grappled with how to address persistent teacher vacancies across Tennessee during its quarterly meeting on Friday. Those vacancies have been filled in part by issuing more emergency credentials, including permits for people teaching without a license
